speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Bill provides for three amendments, which arose from our ongoing review of the GST regime.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Ministry of Finance has evaluated the feedback received from the public consultation and, where appropriate, adopted the suggestions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Comptroller of GST currently already has the power to impose Travel Restriction Orders on persons who fail to pay GST owed to the Government.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Under the GST Tourist Refund Scheme, only eligible tourists are allowed to claim a refund of the GST paid on goods purchased in and brought out of Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: To be eligible for tourist refunds, the individual must meet certain conditions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: For example, he or she must not be a Singaporean Citizen or Permanent Resident, nor a crew member of an aircraft or ship, and is not employed in Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This change will not affect the local tourism industry, as genuine tourists remain eligible to claim the GST refunds and will not be affected by the change.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Under the current legislation, supplies relating to an aircraft qualify for GST zero-rating if the aircraft is not used or not intended to be used for recreation or pleasure.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: If the aircraft is used or intended to be used for recreation or pleasure, then it must be wholly used, or intended to be wholly used, for international travel.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This amendment makes clear the policy intent of zero-rating supplies relating to international travel on the basis that they are not for domestic consumption.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Currently, supplies such as fuel and aircraft handling services, are zero-rated, for GST purposes, only if they were supplied in relation to aircraft that is wholly used for international travel.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: In essence, for such an aircraft, 	Page: 108 the relevant question will be whether the particular flight for which the specified supplies relate to is an international flight.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The final amendment is a technical amendment to make it clear that zero-rating of GST applies to the supply of the goods which are for use as merchandise for retail sale on board an aircraft or ship.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Clause 2 of the Bill gives effect to this change.
